parts.text: Iron is manufactured in a blast furnace.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Three of the starting materials added to the blast furnace are coke, iron ore and limestone. Name the other starting material added to the blast furnace. .............................................................................................................................................. [1]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The source of iron in the blast furnace is Fe 2 O 3 . Fe 2 O 3 is found in iron ore.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) The iron in Fe 2 O 3 is reduced by reaction with carbon monoxide. The unbalanced symbol equation is shown. Complete the equation. Fe 2 O 3 + .....CO → .....CO 2 + .....Fe [1]

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Iron is converted to steel by mixing it with carbon and other elements.

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) Steel can be coated with zinc to prevent rusting. This provides both a barrier method and sacrificial protection.

ms.label: 3(f)(iii)
